title: coach.tips
description: Meeting coach: an optional one-sentence read of what is going on, 0-3 short constructive tips on how to steer the meeting, plus an optional alert (a short command to the viewer, e.g. 'De-escalate now.') when a moment needs action now. Sent within seconds of new words or a long silence; each new event replaces the last.

read.description: What is going on right now, in one sentence (stage, topic, what is missing). Karim 2026-11-16.
